shape_correction.reason: The target evaluates the current token plus two MTP draft tokens. Draft width three produces four rows and routes through the existing GEMM4 kernel, bypassing the fused ragged GEMV.

hypothesis: Matching MTP draft width two to the fused three-row Q4_K AVX2 kernel will improve accepted end-to-end throughput over the same MTP2 configuration on the control runtime.

controls.control_runtime: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order ragged dispatch v1
controls.candidate_runtime: Same source and dispatch plus fused AVX2 Q4_K decode

reuse_policy: Target-only prompt receipts may be reused only from the already terminal 4 x 96 run of the identical runtime binary and frozen generation configuration; each MTP2 configuration must execute fresh.
stop_rules: Reject on any cross-runtime exact-greedy token mismatch.
Reject paired MTP2 promotion below five percent end-to-end speedup.
Do not call MTP2 the serving winner unless it exceeds the measured control MTP3 accepted throughput.
Preserve infrastructure-invalid attempts without assigning a score.
claim_boundary: A paired pass promotes the three-row kernel for MTP2 on this Milan host. The serving-winner gate is separate, and neither gate is final-node or 100 accepted tok/s evidence.
